source_units.text: Write a dialogue in which two fictional siblings resolve a disagreement.
Use at least 60 words and no more than 90 words in total.
Use this fictional material: One sibling borrowed the red scarf without asking and tore it.
The other asks them to ask next time.
End with a shared decision that we can mend it, rather than buying a replacement.
Required wording, verbatim: "the red scarf", "ask next time", "we can mend it".
The audience is readers of an original family scene.
